facts: Delivery (PR 2). Phones register a push token per install; Desktop and the browser workspace hold a stream instead and need no registration.
APNs: the hex device token. FCM: the registration token.
APNs only: which gateway the build's entitlement targets.

The data every push carries (APNs custom keys beside `aps`; FCM `data`, all strings there, so `target` is JSON-encoded on FCM). A tap opens `target`, then marks the notification read with `POST /:id/read`.

ai.title: Push delivery contracts added to notifications module
ai.summary: Adds Zod schemas and TypeScript types for push notification delivery to the shared notification contracts in common/src/notifications/contracts.ts. The new notificationDeviceRegistrationSchema defines fields for registering iOS and Android push tokens, including APNs environment and timezone, while NotificationStreamEvent models the Server-Sent Events payload for Desktop and browser clients. These definitions establish the wire contract for the delivery endpoints referenced in the module header, with comments indicating that target is JSON-encoded on FCM due to string-only data constraints.
ai.evidence: The diff adds notificationPushPlatformSchema, notificationDeviceRegistrationSchema, NotificationDeviceView, NotificationPushData, and NotificationStreamEvent to common/src/notifications/contracts.ts, defining schemas and types for device registration and Server-Sent Events streams under a 'Delivery (PR 2)' comment.
ai.unknowns: The diff defines the contracts but does not show the server implementation or client code that consumes these schemas and types.

eli5.text: The shared rulebook for how alerts reach your devices has been expanded with detailed descriptions for both phone push notifications and the live connection used by desktop and browser apps. This is internal engineering work that defines the exact data and formats the system will use, but no part of it is active yet because the code that actually sends or receives these messages has not been updated. As a result, you will see no change in your daily use of the assistant; this step simply prepares the foundation for future notification features.
